answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each claimed node to a Wesolowski VDF: producing its proof requires continuous sequential modular squarings, while verification is fast. An attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize one chain across GPUs; separate devices can run separate chains, but each still incurs the full delay. Thus a ripple of forged agents, from ember to summit, multiplies wall-clock cost and encounters a strict physical time bottleneck.
